crossRefs.note: He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,
Have mercy on me, Yahweh. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,
For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.
I said, “In the middle of my life I go into the gates of Sheol. I am deprived of the residue of my years.”

translations.web: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.
translations.bsb: They loathed all food and drew near to the gates of death.
translations.kjv: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.
translations.asv: Their soul abhorreth all manner of food; And they draw near unto the gates of death.
